reason: My agency and Rentlio already handle guest messages for the villa, and my guests pay a lot so they expect a person, not a QR code. I don't need another monthly bill on top of what I pay them for a few months of bookings.
objection: It overlaps with what I already pay the agency and channel manager for, and I don't want a robot answering high-end guests who might get something wrong while I'm abroad.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged straight into Rentlio and let me drop the agency's guest communication fee, so it saves me money instead of adding a cost.
